# Figures

## Bulk RNA-seq dataset

* Distribution of samples across age intervals

```{r}
summarise_stats = function(x, dataset)
{
    age = table(x$`Age Interval`) %>% reshape2::melt()
    age$Type = c(paste(dataset, "Sample", sep = "_"))
    individuals = x %>% group_by(`Age Interval`, DonorID) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
        as.data.frame()
    individuals = table(individuals$`Age Interval`) %>% reshape2::melt()
    individuals$Type = c(paste("Individual", dataset, sep = "_"))

    age = rbind(age, individuals)
    colnames(age) = c("Age Interval", "n", "Type")
    age$dataset = c(as.character(dataset))
    return(age)

}

summarise_regions = function(x, dataset){
    regions = x %>%
        dplyr::group_by(`Age Interval`, Regions) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n())  %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(Dataset = dataset)
    return(regions)
}
```


```{r}
age_interval_stats = list()
directory = file.path(here::here("output/metadata"))
pattern = "/home/neuro/Documents/Brain_integrative_transcriptome/bithub/data-preprocessing/output/metadata/"


md = list.files(f, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\-metadata.csv$")

for (j in md) {

  dataset <- gsub(pattern, "", j)
  dataset <- gsub("\\-metadata.csv", "", dataset)
  message("Now calculating statistics for ", dataset)

  if (dataset %in% c("PsychEncode")) {
    ct_file <- read.csv(
      j,
      header = TRUE,
      check.names = FALSE,
    ) %>% mutate(DonorID = SampleID)
  } else {
    ct_file <- read.csv(
      j,
      header = TRUE,
      check.names = FALSE, 
      row.names = 1
    )
  }

  stats <- summarise_stats(ct_file, dataset)
  age_interval_stats[[dataset]] <- stats
}

bulk_plot_dist = age_interval_stats %>%
    do.call(rbind, .) %>%
    mutate(`Age Interval` = factor(`Age Interval`, levels = c("4-7pcw", "8-9pcw",
                                                        "10-12pcw", "13-15pcw", "16-18pcw",
                                                        "19-24pcw", "25-38pcw", "0-5mos",
                                                        "6-18mos", "19mos-5yrs", "6-11yrs",
                                                        "12-19yrs", "20-29yrs", "30-39yrs", "40-49yrs",
                                                        "50-59yrs", "60-69yrs", "70-79yrs", "80-89yrs", "90-99yrs")),
           Type = factor(Type, levels = c("BrainSeq_Sample", "Individual_BrainSeq",
                                          "BrainSpan_Sample", "Individual_BrainSpan",
                                          "PsychEncode_Sample", "Individual_PsychEncode", "GTEx_Sample", "Individual_GTEx",
                                          "HDBR_Sample", "Individual_HDBR"))) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("BrainSeq", "BrainSpan", "PsychEncode", "GTEx", "HDBR"))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x= `Age Interval`, y = n, fill =Type)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge",stat= "identity") +
    facet_grid(dataset~`Age Interval`, scales = "free") + xlab("") + ylab("")  + theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          strip.background =element_rect(fill="darkgrey", color = "#E1DFDB"),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "#f7f4ed", fill = NA, size = 2)) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'white')) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F75E5E", "#FFC6BD",
                                 "#49165E", "#EBBAFF",
                                 "#78A2EB", "#36466A",
                                 "#74C69D", "#2D6A4F",
                                 "#F9AD79", "#FF5F0F")) +
    theme(
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA), # or theme_blank()
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour =NA)
    )


bulk_plot_dist
```
